content.text: I reviewed the entire agreement (single section, 75 paragraphs) and searched for MFN-style language ("most favored nation", "favorable", "best price", matching third-party terms). None exists.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or price/terms-matching obligation in either direction. Searches for "most favored nation", "favorable", "no less favorable", "best price" and third-party term-matching language returned no results, and the only commercial terms provision (§5 Fees and Payment, p0023) is a simple revenue-share deferred to the Exhibits with no MFN or benchmarking mechanic. Section 1 (p0001) further confirms the arrangement is expressly non-exclusive and does not restrict AP from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties, so AP is under no obligation to extend Kubient terms given to others. This matches the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer); no redline is warranted. Note for diligence: MFN risk could still be introduced in an Exhibit, which should be checked when Exhibits are negotiated.
